applicant.name: Dr. Julia Brandstätter
applicant.organisation: Medical University of Graz, cardiology research

request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: Scientific research that trains a prognostic model on individual-level records; only model weights and calibration plots leave the secure processing environment.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised medications and observations of adults with type 2 diabetes who have an active SGLT2 inhibitor.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
SGLT2 inhibitor = ATC code starting with A10BK.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Cohort = adults with type 2 diabetes and an active SGLT2 inhibitor.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
